reviews.title: Great Value SSD
reviews.comment: I chose this product because it was a large size, which was good for the large games I play, and it was cheap. It is significantly faster than what I was using before (an HDD), and it works perfectly. Installation was a breeze. It was super easy to put in and initialize.
